root object
├─ first -> a/b
├─ alias -> #/properties/first
├─ tilde -> tilde~key
├─ emptyName -> #/$defs/
├─ encoded -> a/b
├─ emptyRef -> root [recursive]
├─ notSchema -> #/properties [unresolved]
├─ anchor -> #Value [unresolved]
└─ badEscape -> #/$defs/a~2b [unresolved]

Definitions
├─ a/b string
├─ tilde~key integer
└─ #/$defs/ boolean
